title: Hexagonal Population Surfaces for Canada (H3 Resolutions 6, 7 and 8)
description: National population count and density surfaces for Canada on the H3 hexagonal grid at resolutions 6, 7 and 8, produced by disaggregating 2021 Census Dissemination Block population with a hybrid dasymetric method. Includes the hybrid, Pseudo-Household and National Address Register layers, block-level allocation tables, the source code and documentation. Method described in doi:10.20944/preprints202609.2636.v1.
